info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Notes Retrieval API allows users to access and retrieve detailed notes associated with meetings. This API provides developers with the capability to programmatically obtain notes, ensuring that stakeholders have access to critical information from past discussions. Typical consumers of this API include project managers, team members, and any stakeholders looking to review meeting outcomes. The endpoint supports efficient retrieval of notes, enhancing collaboration and information sharing within organizations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access a list of notes associated with meetings. It provides detailed information about the notes, including their content and related meeting details, helping you stay organized and informed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve notes associated with meetings. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters in the request body to filter or define the specific notes you are interested in.
